source.title: FedEx Dataworks and Stripe to Join Forces to Reduce Friction in Global Commerce for SMBs
source.section: FedEx Dataworks and Stripe to Join Forces to Reduce Friction in Global Commerce for SMBs
source.type: FedEx 与 Stripe 官方商业合作公告
source.context: FedEx / Stripe 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: MEMPHIS, Tenn. / SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif. — October 6, 2026 – Today, FedEx Dataworks and Stripe announced a long-term, strategic collaboration to help reduce friction in global commerce by combining signals from the global FedEx network and Stripe financial infrastructure. The first joint solution is planned for launch in early 2027. The two companies plan to leverage their respective platforms to expand access to financing for tens of thousands of small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Additionally, FedEx will begin using Stripe as an option to process payments, adding more than 50 new payment methods to their checkouts through Stripe.

Securing capital remains a persistent hurdle for logistics-heavy SMBs. Traditional financing models rely on bank statements and credit scores, often overlooking operational indicators such as shipment activity, inventory movement, and fulfillment performance. By leveraging supply chain intelligence from FedEx Dataworks to help inform financing analysis with Stripe Capital, Dataworks and Stripe are seeking to close that gap and enable FedEx SMB customers to access funding that better reflects how they operate. With these real-time operational signals, Stripe will be better positioned to evaluate, approve, and deploy tailored funding more quickly than traditional lending processes, eliminating the friction for SMBs.

“Every day, FedEx helps move more than $2 trillion in global commerce, giving us unique visibility into how businesses operate,” said Vishal Talwar, executive vice president, chief digital and information officer of FedEx Corp., and president of FedEx Dataworks. “Our focus at Dataworks is to leverage that intelligence by building solutions that create value for customers and help make supply chains smarter. This collaboration is an important step in laying the foundation for future innovations across the global economy.”

“FedEx and Stripe power the physical and digital foundations of global trade,” said John Collison, co-founder and president of Stripe. “Together, we can turn the operational momentum of a small business, like shipping a thousand packages a week, into access to growth finance through Stripe Capital.”

FedEx will also use Stripe to expand payment options for FedEx customers globally, adding more than 50 new payment methods to FedEx checkouts. With a wider variety of local payment methods, FedEx can help remove checkout friction so customers can pay how they prefer.

This announcement marks the beginning of a strategic, long-term collaboration between FedEx Dataworks and Stripe, laying the foundation for the next generation of business solutions powered by FedEx Dataworks logistics signals and Stripe’s financial infrastructure. As the collaboration evolves, both companies expect to scale these capabilities to meet the needs of increasingly complex global enterprise.
translations: 2026 年 10 月 6 日，田纳西州孟菲斯 / 加利福尼亚州南旧金山：FedEx Dataworks 与 Stripe 宣布开展长期战略合作，通过结合 FedEx 全球网络信号与 Stripe 金融基础设施，减少全球贸易中的摩擦。首个联合解决方案计划于 2027 年初推出。两家公司计划利用各自平台，扩大数万家中小企业获得融资的机会。此外，FedEx 将开始使用 Stripe 处理支付，为 FedEx 结账增加 50 多种支付方式。

获得资金仍是物流密集型中小企业面临的长期难题。传统融资模型依赖银行流水和信用评分，往往忽略货运活动、库存流动和履约表现等运营指标。FedEx Dataworks 和 Stripe Capital 希望利用供应链信息辅助融资分析，弥补这一缺口，让 FedEx 的中小企业客户获得更能反映其实际经营情况的资金。借助实时运营信号，Stripe 将更有条件评估、批准并更快发放适合企业情况的资金，减少传统贷款流程带来的摩擦。
FedEx Dataworks 总裁 Vishal Talwar 说：“FedEx 每天为全球贸易运输超过 2 万亿美元的货物，因此我们能独特地洞察企业如何运营。Dataworks 致力于利用这些信息，为客户打造有价值的解决方案，让供应链更智能。这次合作是为全球经济未来创新奠定基础的重要一步。”
Stripe 联合创始人兼总裁 John Collison 说：“FedEx 和 Stripe 支撑着全球贸易的实体与数字基础。双方可以把小企业的实际经营势头，例如每周运输一千个包裹，转化为通过 Stripe Capital 获得增长资金的机会。”
FedEx 还将使用 Stripe 扩大其全球客户的支付选项，为 FedEx 结账新增 50 多种支付方式。提供更多本地支付方式后，FedEx 可以减少结账摩擦，让客户按自己偏好的方式付款。
这项公告标志着 FedEx Dataworks 和 Stripe 长期战略合作的开始，为下一代业务解决方案奠定基础，这些方案将由 FedEx Dataworks 的物流信号和 Stripe 的金融基础设施提供支持。随着合作发展，双方预计将扩大这些能力，以满足全球企业日益复杂的需求。

The two companies plan to leverage their respective platforms to expand access to financing for tens of thousands of small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). With these real-time operational signals, Stripe will be better positioned to evaluate, approve, and deploy tailored funding more quickly than traditional lending processes, eliminating the friction for SMBs.

“Every day, FedEx helps move more than $2 trillion in global commerce, giving us unique visibility into how businesses operate,” said Vishal Talwar, executive vice president, chief digital and information officer of FedEx Corp., and president of FedEx Dataworks. “Our focus at Dataworks is to leverage that intelligence by building solutions that create value for customers and help make supply chains smarter. This collaboration is an important step in laying the foundation for future innovations across the global economy.”

“FedEx and Stripe power the physical and digital foundations of global trade,” said John Collison, co-founder and president of Stripe. “Together, we can turn the operational momentum of a small business, like shipping a thousand packages a week, into access to growth finance through Stripe Capital.”

This announcement marks the beginning of a strategic, long-term collaboration between FedEx Dataworks and Stripe, laying the foundation for the next generation of business solutions powered by FedEx Dataworks logistics signals and Stripe’s financial infrastructure. As the collaboration evolves, both companies expect to scale these capabilities to meet the needs of increasingly complex global enterprise.

About StripeStripe is building programmable financial services for millions of businesses globally. Millions of companies use Stripe to accept payments online and in person, embed financial services, power custom revenue models, and build a more profitable business. Headquartered in South San Francisco and Dublin, Stripe processes over $1.9 trillion of payments annually, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP. Stripe users include all of the top AI companies, 90% of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, and 88% of the Forbes AI 50. Through its scale and investments in R&D – particularly artificial intelligence and stablecoins – Stripe accelerates the utility of frontier technology in the global economy.

About FedEx Corp.FedEx Corp. (NYSE: FDX) provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, ecommerce, and business services. With annual revenue of $86 billion, the company offers integrated business solutions utilizing its flexible, efficient, and intelligent global network. Consistently ranked among the world’s most admired and trusted employers, FedEx inspires its more than 450,000 employees to remain focused on safety, the highest ethical and professional standards, and the needs of their customers and communities. FedEx is committed to connecting people and possibilities around the world responsibly and resourcefully, with a goal to achieve carbon-neutral operations by 2040. To learn more, please visit fedex.com/about.

About FedEx DataworksFedEx Dataworks is the insights and intelligence subsidiary of FedEx Corp., moving FedEx beyond transportation and helping to power global commerce through actionable, data-driven solutions. We combine real-world movement data with advanced analytics and agentic capabilities to create products that enable enterprises and ecosystems to seamlessly optimize their value chains. Built on the trust, scale, and the operational DNA of FedEx, we provide insights, automation, and predictive intelligence designed to help businesses shift from reactive visibility to coordinated, proactive action.

scenario.title: 模拟情境：为中小企业设计融资评估试点
english: A logistics-heavy small business has steady shipments but limited credit history.
A payment provider and a logistics platform are exploring a financing service that may use shipment and fulfillment signals.
Describe the business case, explain what data the pilot should use with customer permission, and set measures for access, repayment, and trust.
chinese: 一家物流密集型小企业发货稳定，但信用记录有限。
支付服务商和物流平台正在探索一项可能使用货运与履约信号的融资服务。
请说明业务价值，提出在获得客户许可后试点使用哪些数据，并设置融资可及性、还款表现和客户信任指标。

firstAttempt.prompt: 传统融资评估可能忽略小企业的真实发货和履约情况。请用英语说明拟议中的合作服务如何补充这些信息，并提出上线前要确认的客户授权和后续评估指标。
firstAttempt.sample: Traditional financing models often overlook operational indicators such as shipment activity, inventory movement, and fulfillment performance. The proposed service would combine supply chain signals with financial information to provide an assessment that better reflects how a business operates. Before launch, we should explain what data will be used and obtain customer permission. If the service is tested, we can track time to decision, access to funding, repayment performance, and customer feedback.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先说明拟议服务能补充哪些经营信息，再交代上线前的授权要求和后续测试指标。

choice.prompt: 两家公司已宣布合作，首项联合方案计划于 2027 年初推出，融资服务仍在规划中。若后续进行测试，哪种做法更稳妥？
options: Use all available customer data without explaining how it affects decisions.
Explain the data used, obtain customer permission, compare decisions and repayment outcomes with a baseline, and review customer feedback.
Promise funding to every business with a high shipment count.
choice.why: 第二条先说明数据用途并获得许可，再衡量融资决策、还款表现和客户反馈，没有把运营信号误当作自动批准条件。
